label: defeated opponent
definition: Competitor X defeated opposing competitor Y in a completed sporting or electoral contest.
scope_notes: Beat, defeat, sweep, outlast, rout, upset and explicit victories qualify. Mere playing, facing, standings leads, transfers and losses do not. Historical win evidence suffices even with other losses; geographic team metonymy needs clear competitive roles.

facts.reason: Jets victory-over, defeat and beat Raiders explicitly support a historical win; play and lose-to rows concern additional events.
Giants beat Jets and have victory over them. Loss and game rows can coexist with a win at another time.
Mariners beat and eliminate Yankees, with victory-over support; trades and participation are separate meanings.
East beats and defeats West and is led to victory over West; the complete local evidence fixes opposing competitive sides.
San Diego Padres directly defeat and beat New York Mets. Facing and clubhouse-play rows provide additional non-result evidence.
